recognize_zh: 右下方為較淡染的生發中心，細胞較大、核較淡並有凋亡碎片，外圍與左上方為密集深染的小淋巴球，左上區域可見血管與內皮細胞，呈現生發中心、外套區與濾泡間區的交界。
features: Lower right: pale germinal center with medium-to-large cells, vesicular nuclei and apoptotic debris
Surrounding dense small round lymphocytes with dark chromatin (mantle zone)
Upper left: interfollicular zone with small lymphocytes, pale cells and small vessels with plump endothelium
Occasional red cells and stromal cells
describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium-high power shows a pale germinal center at the lower right composed of larger cells with vesicular nuclei and scattered apoptotic debris, bordered by densely packed small lymphocytes of the mantle zone. The upper left shows the interfollicular region with small lymphocytes, pale cells and small vessels. Zonation is preserved without cytologic atypia. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle and adjacent interfollicular tissue.

ddx.vs: FL shows monotonous centrocyte-rich follicles lacking apoptotic debris with attenuated mantles and BCL2 positivity.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows sheets of monocytoid or centrocyte-like cells replacing interfollicular areas and colonizing follicles, rather than the normal small lymphocytes seen here.
